data.name: Improved Overrun (Mythic)
data.description: You're an unstoppable force on the battlefield, able to run down lesser foes with ease.

raw_tokens.value: You're an unstoppable force on the battlefield, able to run down lesser foes with ease.

You gain a bonus equal to half your tier on checks to overrun, and to your CMD when an opponent tries to overrun you. These bonuses stack with those granted by Improved Overrun.&nl;Furthermore, you can make an attack of opportunity against any creature that attempts to overrun you, unless it also has this feat.
